fromContent: Every Vornic packet carries a drift counter that each relay increments by one.
toContent: Vornic node addresses are 128 bits long and handed out by regional registrars.

fromContent: Glimmer moths navigate by the polarization pattern of moonlight.
toContent: An adult glimmer moth has a wingspan of about four centimetres.
Korl's surface syntax uses significant indentation rather than curly braces to delimit blocks.

fromContent: Unspent tithe-credits lose ten percent of their value each cycle.
toContent: Tithe-credits are minted as small hexagonal copper tokens stamped with the council seal.

fromContent: The warden piece moves only along diagonals.
toContent: A Castellan board has eighty-one tiles arranged in a nine-by-nine grid.

fromContent: Lumen trees photosynthesize from infrared radiation rather than visible light.
toContent: Lumen-tree wood is prized by instrument makers for its unusually even resonance.

fromContent: Only anchor nodes reset a Vornic packet's drift counter to zero.
toContent: Vornic relays forward waiting packets using a least-drift-first queue discipline.
subtype: co-occurrence — both about Vornic drift handling, embedding-near, independent mechanisms

fromContent: Glimmer-moth larvae feed only on the saber fern.
toContent: A glimmer moth completes its entire life cycle within a single lunar month.
subtype: co-occurrence — two glimmer biology facts, independent

fromContent: Every Korl function is pure, free of side effects.
toContent: The Korl standard library ships with just over one thousand built-in functions.

fromContent: Merchants must accept tithe-credits at full face value.
toContent: The tithe-council convenes at each solstice to fix that season's issue amount.

fromContent: Every Daftari write operation auto-commits to git; git is the version-control layer and there is no separate versioning subsystem.
toContent: The .daftari/index.db SQLite file is ephemeral: it is the search/ACL index and can be rebuilt from the markdown files at any time.
subtype: co-occurrence — two Daftari persistence facts, independent (validated in v1)

fromContent: Daftari's vault_lint reports curation problems but never auto-fixes them; the curation engine is advisory.
toContent: Daftari's vault_tension_log records tensions between documents but never resolves them; recording a tension does not act on it.
subtype: co-occurrence — common-cause siblings of 'curation engine is advisory' (validated in v1)

fromContent: Lumen trees shed their outer bark whenever the temperature drops below freezing.
toContent: The sap of a lumen tree conducts electricity readily.

fromContent: A Castellan keep may not move onto any tile a warden threatens.
toContent: Because the warden moves diagonally, each warden only ever threatens tiles of a single colour.
subtype: co-occurrence — two Castellan rules; share 'warden/threat' vocabulary but neither is the other's premise
